Context: Educationally Backward Classes (OBCs)

5. Sub-quota of 4.5% for Minorities with effect from 1-1-2012.It has been decided to carve out a sub-quota of 4.5% for Minorities as defined under Section 2 (c) of the National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992, from within the 27% reservation for OBCs in Government employment.  
- OM, dated 22-12-2011.
